question: Should this MEMBER-authored automerge telemetry change land after a maintainer verifies failed-repair and requeue-race behavior in the real workflow?
rationale: The patch changes durable automerge session outcomes and workflow failure reconciliation; tests and static checks are useful but cannot settle the intended production semantics alone.

options.title: Validate and merge
options.body: Run or inspect a real failed repair and successful requeue race, then merge if each session receives the intended idempotent terminal or active state.

options.title: Defer terminalization
options.body: Keep the scheduled reconciliation behavior while maintainers decide whether repair failures should enter the automerge success-rate denominator.

recommendation.title: Validate and merge
recommendation.body: Run or inspect a real failed repair and successful requeue race, then merge if each session receives the intended idempotent terminal or active state.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current reconciliation implementation and can provide the most direct technical context for the proposed state transition.
